A student uses a stopwatch to determine the period of oscillation of a pendulum.
The initial reading on the stopwatch is 5.64s.
The student starts the stopwatch, and then stops it after the pendulum has completed
15 oscillations.
The final reading on the stopwatch is 25.16s.
What is the period of oscillation of the pendulum?
A
0.38s
B
1.30s
C
1.68s
D
2.05s
subject: Physics
